scenes.scene_gsap: function initScene(tl, start, dur) { const scene = document.querySelector('[data-scene-id="scene_01"]'); const object = scene.querySelector('#b01_object'); const force = scene.querySelector('#b01_force'); const result = scene.querySelector('#b01_result'); tl.fromTo(object, { opacity: 0, y: 20 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.25 }, start); tl.fromTo(force, { opacity: 0, scaleX: 0, transformOrigin: 'left center' }, { opacity: 1, scaleX: 1, duration: 0.35 }, start + 0.25); tl.to(object, { x: 180, duration: 0.35 }, start + 0.55); tl.fromTo(result, { opacity: 0, scale: 0.8 }, { opacity: 1, scale: 1, duration: 0.25 }, start + 0.85); tl.to(scene.querySelector('.camera'), { scale: 1.01, duration: dur, ease: 'none' }, start); }
